display_long_description:
**Your favorite childhood game is back — only this time, it’s on a whole new level.**  

Thanks to mixed reality, **Balloon Duel: The Keepy-Uppy Game** turns your home into a lively playground where every hit feels real. The balloon bounces off your furniture, flies through portals, and dodges fans and other surprises that keep every match unpredictable.  

Challenge a cast of **AI opponents with distinct personalities** — some are lightning-fast, others deviously smart, and all will push your reflexes to the limit.  

As you rise through the challenges, **your surroundings evolve**: floating rocks drift across the room, ice cubes spin in midair, corn cobs roll under your feet, and neon lights transform your home into a surreal playground.  

**Balloon Duel** blends nostalgia with modern mixed reality to create something simple, immediate, and irresistibly fun.  

**Because sometimes, the best game is the one that makes you feel like a kid again, playing with a balloon.**
